known_secrets.text: The oldest Great Bath chants describe watching the water's color and level, phrased as speech to a spirit.
Nara believes the earliest rites were once practical river-observation disguised as ceremony.
She knows of no plain, unceremonial version of the oldest chants; one may have been lost when Elira's role ended.
Her telling of the Turning has shifted slightly across retellings, which she admits openly to Sena.
